notes: Third, independent hint source for acquisition_intelligence.target.generate_company_ir_targets(), alongside discovery.wikidata_lookup.WikidataOfficialWebsiteClient and discover_company_directory_links() -- see docs/TECHNICAL_DEBT.md TD-38. Each hostname below was returned by a live web search for the company's own name plus 'EGX official website' and is never asserted as collectable: acquisition_intelligence.domain_resolution.HeuristicDomainResolver still independently probes it for reachability before anything is trusted, exactly like every other domain_hints entry in target.py. Entries omitted here (EGCH, HELI, MCQE, OIH, PHDC) had no single, confidently-resolvable official domain in search results -- either nothing found, only a parent-group page, or multiple conflicting look-alike domains -- and are deliberately left for manual review rather than guessed.
